findings.description: best_score calls max() without handling an empty list, but the new _log_best_score in agents.py calls it on every retrieval result, including empty ones. should_abstain guarded the empty case with `not chunks`, and that guard no longer protects this path.
findings.rationale: When retrieve() returns an empty list (for example, a query that matches nothing or an empty index), best_score([]) raises ValueError from max(). _log_best_score runs right after retrieve in the agent's retrieval step, so the agent crashes instead of abstaining. The debug call is made unconditionally, so this happens even when debug logging is disabled.
